GPL files in GameMog's Story Kit

The Story Kit's voices turn text into phonemes with eSpeak NG, as the separate file phonemizer.js. It is licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later, and served unmodified. Nothing else GameMog serves is built from it.
